2607.17774.title: Persona-as-Configuration: Generative Stakeholder Reporting for Agricultural Floods
2607.17774.paper_summary: Cyber-physical systems built on deterministic edge inference, such as on-vehicle flood detection for agricultural fields, produce structured decision logs that must be interpreted differently by heterogeneous stakeholders. Pairing such systems with large language models (LLMs) to generate stakeholder-specific reports introduces a tension: the generative layer is non-deterministic, while the edge plane must remain replayable and auditable. We propose an architectural pattern resting on two invariants: unidirectional consumption, in which the generative layer is a strict read-only consumer of the deterministic plane and never writes back, and persona-as-configuration, in which stakeholder adaptation is a versioned prompt-template artifact rather than runtime improvisation. We instantiate the pattern as a context-aware dashboard layer over the JSON decision logs of a previously published edge-based standing-water detection system, and analyse how the integration boundary admits standard generative-reliability mitigations as configuration- or middleware-level extension points. A structured expert review rated the pattern favourably across five ISO/IEC 25010-aligned quality dimensions, with strongest agreement on separation of concerns. End-user evaluation with agricultural stakeholders is planned for future work.
2607.17774.paper_summary_zh: 基於確定性邊緣推理的網絡物理系統，例如用於農業田地的車載洪水檢測，生成的結構化決策日誌必須由異質利益相關者以不同方式解讀。將這些系統與大型語言模型（LLMs）配對，以生成特定於利益相關者的報告，會引入一種緊張關係：生成層是非確定性的，而邊緣層必須保持可重播和可審計。我們提出一種基於兩個不變性的架構模式：單向消費，其中生成層是確定性平面的嚴格只讀消費者，並且從不寫回，以及作為配置的人物，其中利益相關者的適應是一種版本化的提示模板工件，而不是運行時即興創作。我們將該模式實現為一個上下文感知的儀表板層，覆蓋先前發表的基於邊緣的靜水檢測系統的JSON決策日誌，並分析集成邊界如何允許標準生成可靠性緩解作為配置或中介層擴展點。結構化專家評審在五個與ISO/IEC 25010對齊的質量維度上對該模式給予了良好的評價，對關注點分離的共識最強。計劃在未來的工作中進行與農業利益相關者的最終用戶評估。
